title: Election Observer & Coordinator Training with League of Women Voters VT
description: LWV Vermont is recruiting volunteers to serve as community election observer coordinators and election poll observers statewide. The program takes place outside the polls, in parking lots and near voting entrances, with the goal of removing fear and normalizing voting during these polarizing times. Both observers and coordinators must attend one free Zoom training. Questions: membership@lwvofvt.org
notes: Sign-up link is a Mailchimp tracking link from the source newsletter — could not verify the final destination; confirm it resolves correctly before relying on it.

notes: No sign-up link given on the flyer. This is the rally that precedes the Panton/Waltham canvass (row already in sheet, 2:30–5 pm at the same location).
